content: {"praised":["Gwyneth Paltrow delivers elegant, charismatic performance","Jeremy Northam portrays Mr. Knightly with reserved dignity","Toni Collette, Polly Walker, Ewan McGregor add depth","Film is light‑hearted, romantic, faithful to Austen’s tone","Cast creates a dream ensemble","Production feels polished and engaging"],"criticized":["Film takes many liberties, altering key scenes","Characters are changed or omitted from the book","Gwyneth’s portrayal is contrived and stilted","Production feels abbreviated and rushed","Storyline is shortened, losing depth"]}
